# Seed File Attribution

Master DXF seeded from [ezdxf](https://github.com/mozman/ezdxf) example files.

- **Source:** `examples_dxf/uncommon.dxf`
- **License:** MIT (Copyright (c) 2010-2024, Manfred Moitzi)

- **Purpose:** Stress test with 18 entity types including DIMENSION, SPLINE, MESH, 3DSOLID, MULTILEADER.
